evidence_slice: North Tyneside Council's Local Plan Webinar Q&A identifies site 3092A in the North West as a possible housing allocation and states that the landowner must demonstrate that constraints including access and Biodiversity Net Gain can be addressed, otherwise the site will be removed from the Local Plan. The Council's published Initial Draft Local Plan response documents identify 3092A/3092B as Land at East Wideopen. The initial-draft consultation closed on 25 February 2026. The later Publication Draft Local Plan page confirms the plan remains a future planning framework subject to consultation before independent examination.
